name: The Legend of Zuri
source:
Supported by her potty-mouthed fairy servant Siofra, Zuri will encounter a variety of fantasy creatures, lewd bar patrons and suitors while trying to maintain her composure. Zuri has plenty of opportunities to make the wrong decision that end her adventure prematurely but that is all part of the fun. Effects of your decisions are immediate so you can easily reload a save to see how things go when you choose another option.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在她大嘴的仙女仆人西奥弗拉的支持下，祖里在努力保持镇静的同时，会遇到各种幻想生物、淫荡的酒吧顾客和追求者。祖里有很多机会做出错误的决定，从而过早结束她的冒险，但这正是乐趣的一部分。你的决定的效果是立竿见影的，因此你可以轻松地重新加载保存，以查看当你选择另一个选项时情况如何。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299840/]Steam[/url]]
